facts.text: Mentone was founded as a resort town named after the Italian town of Menton.
Streets such as Cremona, Florence, Venice, Milan and Naples echo the suburb’s Italian resort theme.
Mentone Beach runs along Beaumaris Bay, featuring a surf lifesaving club, playground and Bay Trail sections.
The area now known as Mentone was part of the Bunurong people’s traditional Kulin territory for tens of thousands of years.
A new train station opened in 2017 on the west side of Southland near Bay Street, replacing the old Balcombe Road stop.
Mentone is linked to the Heidelberg School of Australian art, home to painters like Arthur Streeton.
